title: The Effect of Extremist Violence on Hateful Speech Online
benchmark_measurement: The paper quantifies the causal impact of extremist violence events (both Islamist and Islamophobic) on the volume and type of online hate speech and counter-hate speech targeting Muslims and Islam on Twitter and Reddit.
findings: Extremist violence leads to an increase in online hate speech, particularly messages directly advocating violence. Following Islamist terrorist attacks, there is a consistent and significant increase in high-severity hate speech targeting Muslims and Arabs, as well as an increase in counter-hate speech defending them. The reaction to Islamophobic attacks is less consistent across platforms and events. Twitter, more than Reddit, shows an increase in messages framing the events by proposing 'solutions' like banning or deporting Muslims.
